config.title: Morning or Afternoon Berlin Walking Tour - FAQ
config.subtitle: How daylight, heat and museum hours decide the time of a walking tour in Berlin.

items.q: Is a morning or afternoon walking tour better in Berlin?
items.a: It depends on the season. **From November to January, walk through the middle of the day**, because the sun sets between about 15:50 and 16:50. On a hot summer day choose the morning: the highest temperature of the day usually comes at 16:00 or later. In spring and autumn both work, so decide by the one appointment you cannot move.

items.q: What time does it get dark in Berlin in December?
items.a: On 21 December the sun rises at 08:15 and sets at 15:54, which gives 7 hours and 39 minutes of daylight, and it is dark by about 16:40. **For an outdoor walk, start by midday.** A walk that begins at 14:00 has its last stops around sunset.

items.q: What is the hottest time of day in Berlin in summer?
items.a: Later than noon. In ten summers of hourly readings from the Berlin-Tempelhof weather station, 2016 to 2025, **the highest reading of the day came at 16:00, 17:00 or 18:00 on two days out of three**. On days that reached 30 °C the average was 26 °C at 10:00, 32 °C at 16:00 and still 30 °C at 19:00, so 10:00 is about six degrees cooler than 16:00.

items.q: Can I visit Museum Island after a walking tour?
items.a: Yes, if the tour ends early enough and it is not Monday, when the Museum Island museums are closed. The Neues Museum and the Alte Nationalgalerie are open from 10:00 to 18:00. The Altes Museum and the Bode-Museum close at 17:00 from Tuesday to Friday. **The state museums count Tuesday to Friday from 15:00 as a time with fewer visitors.** Hours checked on 30 September 2026.

items.q: What time does the BerlinWalk walking tour start?
items.a: Berlin Then and Now has one start: **12:30 at the World Clock on Alexanderplatz**, on selected days. It ends at Hackescher Markt at about 15:00, after about 2.5 hours and about 3 km. The price is €25 per person, with at most 10 people in the group. Dates are on the booking page.

items.q: What fits before and after a 12:30 walking tour?
items.a: Before the walk, one museum at 10:00 and an early lunch. After 15:00 it depends on the season. **From mid-November to mid-January you have about an hour of daylight left, so do the outdoor part first and then go inside.** In spring and autumn Museum Island is the easy next step: its entrances are under ten minutes on foot from Hackescher Markt, where my walk ends. On a hot summer day, go indoors after the walk and come back out at about 20:00; it is still 30 °C at 19:00.

items.q: What if the 12:30 start does not fit my day?
items.a: Pick another date on the booking page. You can change the date or cancel at no cost up to 24 hours before. **I also do private walks at a time you arrange with me**: €249 with up to 6 people or €299 with up to 10, about 2.5 hours.
